newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates Australia Telstra Ffr bonds AA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates Australia Telstra Ffr bonds AA.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it had assigned an AA rating to Australian government-owned telecoms carrier Telstra Corp's 1.5 billion French franc six percent Eurobonds maturing December 11, 2006.
"The rating reflects Telstra's dominant market position, very strong financials and continued government ownership," Standard and Poor's (S&P) said in a statement.
The agency said the rating was constrained by the AA foreign currency sovereign rating of the Commonwealth of Australia, although it said the outlook for this rating was positive.
S&P said the Australian government's plan to sell a third of Telstra was unlikely to weaken the company's credit strength.
"Of likely greater impact to Telstra's rating will be the shape and intensity of competition as the Australian telecommunications market is further opened to competition in 1997," the agency said.
